description: Actual forest-green full-length opaque square-neck fitted wool overdress with gold knotwork woven trim around neckline, bodice sides, cuffs and vertical skirt edges, cream underdress visible through front walking opening, woven belt with round metal buckle, two round shoulder brooches, green-brown patterned fringed shawl resting along elbows and arms, dark plain shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon.
